hypotheses.C0_native_branch_recomposes: The unedited manual branch reproduces native final logits within 1e-4 maximum absolute error.
hypotheses.C1_native_L8H2_cue_edge_transfers_style: Replacing the native L8H2 cue edge by its counterfactual write shifts the disjoint spelling contrast correctly in at least 75% of examples in every cell.
hypotheses.C2_upstream_effect_is_specific: The L8H2 cue-edge mean exceeds both the L8H1 cue and matched noncue L8H2 means by at least 5x in every cell.
hypotheses.C3_L9H8_boundary_change_mediates: Freezing the L9H8 boundary edge to its pre-upstream value removes at least 50% of the L8H2 cue-edge signed mean in every cell.
hypotheses.C4_downstream_mediation_is_specific: L9H8 boundary freezing removes at least 0.20 more fractional effect than both L9H7 boundary and L9H8 matched-nonboundary freezing in at least five of six cells.
hypotheses.C5_declared_contrast_beats_random: The native L8H2 cue-edge shift and its L9H8-mediated component each exceed the 95th percentile of balanced random target-token contrasts in at least five of six cells.
